Install JFrog Boost v0.15.4 for darwin/arm64?

pi-jfrog-boost will download boost-darwin-arm64.tar.gz (14.2 MB) from github.com/jfrog/boost,
check it against the SHA-256 GitHub publishes for it,
and place the boost binary at ~/.local/bin/boost. That is all it does:
  • it does not run JFrog's install.sh
  • it does not change your shell startup files or PATH
  • it does not run `boost init`, so no hooks are added to other agents
  • it does not accept JFrog's Preview Agreement for you

MCP compaction works right away (Boost ≥ 0.15.3). Shell-output compaction is
off by default in Boost; turn it on for pi with /boost settings → Shell output.
PDF/Office conversion needs the agreement: in a terminal run
`boost init --dry-run`, then `boost init`.
Terms: https://boost.jfrog.com/preview-agreement/
